title: Derived representative of a supplied finite-realized class
statement: For an arbitrary finite realization eW, supported-source isomorphism s, line isomorphism line and degree-two arrow alpha, the derived representative of finiteRealizedClass(alpha) is single(s inverse), followed by the exact derived image of alpha with its single and shift comparisons, followed by shifted single(line).

source.place: paragraph (1), finite cyclic reduction followed by finite coefficient extension

proof.text: Expand the actual definition of finiteRealizedClass and cancel Ext.homEquiv with its inverse. The endpoint and shift maps remain precisely those in the definition.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (1), finite cyclic reduction followed by finite coefficient extension
proof_origin.note: Separate the supported-constant and positive-root endpoint calculations from naturality of an arbitrary diagonal arrow.

theorem finiteRealizedClass_hom
    {R : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}}
    [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R] {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A]
    (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (Y : Scheme.{u})
    {L : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules R X}
    (eW : FiniteRealization R A (diagonalSurface Y))
    (line : eW.F.obj (L (diagonalSurface Y)) ≅ geoCartierLine A N hA (diagonalSurface Y))
    (s : eW.F.obj (source R Y) ≅
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (diagonalImmersion Y)).obj
        (geoCartierConstant A (ProjectiveLine Y)))
    (α : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules R (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).obj
      (source R Y) ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules R (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).obj
        (L (diagonalSurface Y)))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) :
    (finiteRealizedClass N hA Y eW line s α).hom =
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map s.inv ≫
        SpTowerClasses.mapSingleArrow eW.F (X := source R Y)
          (Y := L (diagonalSurface Y)) (2 : ℤ) α ≫
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map line.hom)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧')
